title: Galley telemetry contracts v2
description: FROZEN interface between teams. Hardware emits SerialFrame (1 line of JSON per second, USB serial 115200 baud). Software consumes SerialFrame and DailyRecord. Biotech produces DailyRecord datasets. Any change needs agreement of the teams that use it.

SerialFrame.description: Hardware -> Software, 1 Hz, newline-terminated JSON. Example: {"t":1731600000,"hr":62,"spo2":97,"temp":36.6,"q":1,"src":"sensor"}

t.description: Unix time (s) or millis() since boot if no clock

q.description: Signal quality: 1 valid (finger detected, stable), 0 invalid

src.description: sensor = real reading, sim = firmware/simulator fallback

DailyRecord.description: One day per crew member (dataset row, manual entry, or daily summary of SerialFrames). Keys match contracts/medical-ranges-config.json.

sep_active.description: Solar energetic particle event active (NASA DONKI)
